title: Editorial permission routing corrected during regression testing
summary: Tests exposed missing shared permission routing for the new editor endpoint. Editor access now reaches the route checks; publication and rollback remain owner-only.

changes.detail: Registered the explicit editorial API path in shared admin permission routing while retaining handler-level view/edit and owner-only publish/rollback checks.
API, public reader, component-hook and legacy compatibility regressions. Corrected the SQL test provider label to the allowed openai value without any provider request.

validation.name: Initial SQL run
validation.detail: 6/7 passed; one synthetic completion used an intentionally unsupported mock provider label. Fixture corrected; seven passed on rerun.

validation.name: Initial API run
validation.detail: Seven authorization scenarios failed because the new route was not registered for staff. Fixed mapping; 9/9 API tests now pass.

validation.name: Editor interactions
validation.detail: 5/5 component-hook cases passed, including conflict text retention, explicit rebase, RTL and unmount.

validation.name: Final regression
validation.detail: Broader final rerun and static checks pending. Hosted operations remain blocked.
